name: A clear lower-exposure route
description: For a little more walking time, the lower-exposure route passes at least 15% fewer weighted reports in more than 9 of 10 simulations.

name: Routes too close to call
description: The routes' reported-incident counts overlap too much to call one lower, so WayKin says it doesn't matter.

name: Closure on the route
description: Start the walk, then trigger the scripted closure on the route: the walker's app reroutes around it.
